name: Clyde Redford
original_name: クライド・レッドフォード
source:
“Because making that person happy is my own happiness.”

He lost his parents at a young age and lived in an orphanage, but the Earl of Cavendish recognized his talent for the piano and took him in. He currently attends the Royal Academy of Music, where he tells Alice Charlotte—who is not allowed to leave—about the world outside. He harbors a faint crush on Alice Charlotte, but so far there is absolutely no sign that she has noticed.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
